management_remarks: In Q2 FY25, ICICI Bank achieved healthy profit after tax growth of 14.5% year-on-year driven by sustained business banking momentum and high-quality corporate lending. Average current and savings account deposits grew steadily while total term deposit mobilization outpaced industry averages through our 6,600-plus branch network. Return on Assets stood at an industry-leading 2.32% and Return on Equity exceeded 17.8%, underscoring our risk-calibrated core operating profitability.
analyst_qa: Regarding unsecured retail delinquencies, industry-wide microfinance and personal loan stress remains challenging, so our growth in unsecured credit is deliberately moderating. Deposit pricing remains competitive and uncertain given tight system liquidity, requiring calibrated branch-level cost management. While corporate credit quality is stable, global macro headwinds and volatile treasury yields keep us cautious on duration risk.
